supported_checks.source_quote: intravenous methylprednisolone (500 mg daily) and oral cyclophosphamide (100 mg daily) for three days
supported_checks.explanation: The dose and frequency are supported.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: Full thickness mucosal ulceration and inflammation throughout the terminal ileum and large bowel
supported_checks.source_quote: Histopathology showed full thickness mucosal ulceration and inflammation throughout the terminal ileum and large bowel
supported_checks.explanation: The histopathology result is accurately represented.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: Diarrhea persisted up to six liters daily despite treatment
supported_checks.source_quote: His diarrhea persisted up to six liters daily despite empirical treatment with maximal doses of antidiarrheals, octreotide and cholestyramine.
supported_checks.explanation: The stated persistence and volume despite treatment are supported.

findings.label_excerpt: Diagnosed with histologically confirmed glomerulonephritis secondary to ANCA-positive microscopic polyangiitis
findings.source_quote: A 60-year-old male was diagnosed with histologically confirmed glomerulonephritis secondary to anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody -positive microscopic polyangiitis, following investigations for elevated creatinine on routine blood test.
findings.explanation: The note establishes the diagnosis but does not say this first hospital course was an admission; this reason may conflate diagnosis with admission evidence under the policy requiring evidence of admission.

findings.source_quote: Cyclophosphamide was initially reduced to 50 mg daily and then ceased in setting of potential infectious pathology.
findings.explanation: The label omits the clinically material reduction and cessation of cyclophosphamide during the second course. This is a treatment course with explicit dose and status, expressible in the treatment schema.

findings.label_excerpt: Denuded and erythematous mucosa in the duodenum, as well as from sigmoid colon to terminal ileum with no significant interval change in macroscopic appearance
findings.explanation: The examination result omits the source's material qualification that the rectum was relatively spared.

findings.label_excerpt: Full thickness mucosal ulceration and inflammation throughout the terminal ileum and large bowel
findings.source_quote: There were no features of inflammatory bowel disease, vasculitis or viral inclusions.
findings.explanation: The label omits significant negative histopathology findings relevant to the reported evaluation.

initial.summary: Candidate issues include a possible unsupported admission role for the first diagnosis and omitted material treatment-course and investigation details.
